thread:
Elena J: FYI — ModelCo wants to list their open weights in our cloud marketplace but their lawyer added a weird "redistribution" clause. Can we sync on whether this blocks listing? :eyes:
Samir P: can you paste the clause? sounds like the usual gotchas (no commercial redistribution, or downstream sublicensing).
Elena J: pasted below from their counsel:
```
Redistribution Restriction: Licensee shall not distribute, sublicense, or make available the model weights, checkpoints, or raw parameter files to any third party or marketplace without prior written consent of Provider. This restriction does not apply to model serving via a managed API where weights remain under Provider control.
```
Samir P: ahh — they want to allow managed API hosting but forbid vendors/marketplaces that hand out files. That could be compatible with our hosted offering, but prevents a marketplace listing that includes downloadable weights.
Marco R: we need to clarify: our marketplace has two listing types — "Hosted (run by Redwood)" and "Bring-your-own-hosting" where customers get a link to download. If ModelCo forbids downloads, they can still do Hosted.
Priya (Legal): @Elena J please confirm whether ModelCo intends to permit Redwood to host the model in our Dedicated/Private offerings (customer-managed infra). The clause as written blocks handing files to customers, which would make Dedicated/private impossible unless we interpret "managed API" broadly.
Elena J: Good point. I asked them: do you consider a Dedicated instance (customer rents GPUs via Redwood, weights deployed in customer's VPC) "managed API"? They replied ambiguous.
Priya (Legal): We should push a small rewrite that preserves their control over public redistribution but allows "operational deployment" for hosting variants. Suggested redline:
```
Permitted Operational Use: Provider grants Licensee the right to deploy and operate the Model on Licensee's hosting environments (including hosted, dedicated, and private deployment modes) for the purpose of providing inference services to end users, provided that Licensee does not publish or otherwise distribute the underlying model weight files to third parties. Commercial redistribution (i.e., making weights available for download or resale) remains prohibited without prior written consent.
```
Samir P: that looks good — lets us run Hosted, Dedicated (since weights stay in infra), and prevent downloads.
Marco R: also flag export controls & embargoed-country language. We should add: "Licensee will not enable deployment in embargoed jurisdictions and will comply with export laws."
Priya (Legal): Agreed. I'll draft the final paragraph and loop in ModelCo counsel. Also recommend a short joint announcement checklist: 1) Confirm permitted listing type (Hosted only vs download allowed), 2) Confirm attribution & model card text, 3) Decide whether a co-branded blog is allowed, 4) Approve timeline and embargoes.
Elena J: Perfect. I'll ask for the approval on the redline and the announcement checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
partnerships-bot: Reminder — partnership intake form for ModelCo (ID #MC-2026) updated by Elena J — https://redwood.example/partnerships/MC-2026
Samir P: once Priya sends the redline I'll schedule a 15m sync with ModelCo this week (opt: Tues/Thu morning).
Marco R: Tue morning works for me.
Priya (Legal): I'll send the redline by EOD and include the export control snippet.
Elena J: Closing loop: ModelCo responded "okay to hosted + dedicated with restrictions, no downloads" — moving to contract redline stage.
